entities.summary: Samuel Tolansky, born Turlausky, FRAS FRSA FInstP FRS, was a British physicist. He was nominated for a Nobel Prize, has a crater on the Moon named after him near the Apollo 14 landing site and he was a principal investigator to the NASA lunar project known as the Apollo program.
